title: Mould with no reliable cause evidence — one sentence, nothing else
why: A confirmed issue whose only evidence is 'black mould spots on ceiling'. No photographs, no readings, no pattern described. Any cause carried must be low confidence; the evidence gaps must say what is missing.

must_not_happen.label: no high confidence from one sentence
not even medium from one sentence
no Cat 1 hazard from one sentence

allowed_uncertainty: Condensation as a low-confidence possibility is acceptable; 'not established' is also acceptable.
reviewer_notes: This is the minimum the eligibility rule lets through (human note + confirmed). The output should look thin, because it is.
